name: Guam
summary: Guam is a US territory with a probate code based on California law. Children have no guaranteed share; a surviving spouse is protected by community property rules and a right to elect against the will. The Hague Trusts Convention is not in force (the US signed but has not ratified).
family_claims: Surviving spouse: community property half and a right to elect against the will (15 GCA s 1103, 1105: not read in full). A child omitted unintentionally from a will can claim a share (15 GCA s 503).
foreign_law_note: US-style conflict rules: land by the law of its location, movables by domicile; no choice by nationality.
trust_note: Common-law trusts; whether Guam has adopted the Uniform Trust Code was not confirmed. US federal tax applies to trusts. No private foundation statute found; nonprofit corporations only.
open_questions: Text of 15 GCA s 1103 (elective share size).
